svg.text: Stretch wedding limousine · Imogen Ash — contestant vehicle dossier
“I was nine words from married. He never heard the other nine.”
Dragging tin cans + a single white shoe
Dead bouquet — fresh the morning of, never replaced
Rice still on the seats; a tuxedo folded inside
A decayed 1990s white stretch limousine gone
gray, dragging tin cans and a single white shoe,
a faded “just married” placard, a dead bouquet
wired to the rear, rice still on the seats, eerie
Realistic · Symmetry On · Quad · ~50k tris · PBR 4K
